summary: Launch-prep exhaustive real-time DB persistence audit (iteration 20). Built /app/backend/tests/test_audit_iter20.py covering all 5 NEW audit hooks (/chat/accept, /chat/decline, /chat/delete, /chat/meeting-report, /chat/meeting-status, /user/pictures/upload-batch) plus full signup/match/chat flow PostgREST persistence verification. 20/20 NEW tests PASS and 13/13 iter14 regression tests still PASS (33/33 total). Every WRITE endpoint produced AT LEAST one row in Supabase. Zero '[audit] ... failed (non-blocking)' warnings and zero Postgres 42501 RLS errors in backend.err.log during the test run. Bootstrap line '✅ All audit tables present. Audit logging is fully active.' is still printed on startup.

minor.issue: UserProfileRequest (server.py:312-352) does NOT declare a 'visibilityToggles' field, so the branch at server.py:1177 (`if hasattr(req, 'visibilityToggles') and req.visibilityToggles`) is dead code — toggle_visibility_profile audit rows are never written when the request goes through this endpoint. Either (a) add `visibilityToggles: Optional[Dict[str, bool]] = None` to UserProfileRequest, or (b) drop the dead branch. NEW user signups currently produce ZERO rows in the toggle_visibility_profile table from this path.

action_items: (Optional cleanup, NOT a launch-blocker) Either add `visibilityToggles: Optional[Dict[str, bool]] = None` to UserProfileRequest (server.py:312) so visibility toggles actually persist during signup, OR remove the dead `hasattr` branch at server.py:1177. As of iter20, the toggle_visibility_profile audit table never receives a row during the /user/profile call.
critical_code_review_comments: All 5 new audit hooks correctly wrap log_match_event / log_picture_event in try/except so audit failures are non-blocking (verified — endpoints return 200 even on hypothetical Supabase errors).
The 6 new try/except blocks log via logger.warning('[audit] ... log failed: ...') making future failures observable in backend.err.log without breaking the API contract.

Schema mapping is correct: 'match_events' table accepts the supplied event_type strings ('request_accepted', 'request_declined', 'chat_deleted', 'meeting_reported', 'meeting_verified') — PostgREST queries filtered by event_type=eq.<value> returned the expected rows.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_audit_iter20.py (NEW — 20 tests covering signup, match, chat, and 5 new audit hooks with PostgREST persistence verification)
seed_data_creation: One ephemeral test user created per run via /api/auth/send-email-otp + /api/auth/verify-otp (mock OTP). Test user is prefixed TEST_dataflow_<timestamp>_<uuid8>@example.com for easy cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 newly-added audit hooks in server.py are verified end-to-end against Supabase PostgREST: /chat/accept→match_events('request_accepted'), /chat/decline→match_events('request_declined'), /chat/delete→match_events('chat_deleted'), /chat/meeting-report→match_events('meeting_reported'), /chat/meeting-status→match_events('meeting_verified'), /user/pictures/upload-batch→user_pictures(action='upload', one row per picture). Existing hooks (signup data, top movies, mode, preferences, exclusive toggle, expand_if_run_out, login, tina chat, user chat, matches generated, unmatch, report) also persist correctly. ONLY KNOWN GAP: visibilityToggles field is missing from UserProfileRequest pydantic model so the toggle_visibility_profile table never receives signup-time writes (dead branch at server.py:1177). Not a launch blocker, but worth fixing for full data flow.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Issue noted (visibilityToggles dead branch) is a pre-existing design gap, not a regression from the new audit hooks.
